attributes.title: Nginx Proxy Manager - Web Threats
attributes.description: Nginx Proxy Manager access/error logs and TLS certificate probes: 4xx/5xx by status, client (canonical srcip -> IP-IOC + GeoIP) and proxy host; probes for sensitive files, admin panels, path traversal and JNDI lookups; content-discovery scans and 401/403 brute force; upstream outages; certificate expiry. Successful requests and uptime-monitor checks are below the alert threshold and not shown. Several panels are forward-looking and populate when the event first occurs.
